chunks: Muhammad ibn al-Hasan (may God be pleased with him) narrated that Abdullah ibn Ja'far al-Humayri narrated to me, Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa narrated to me, Abu Yahya Suhayl ibn Ziyad al-Wasiti, linking it up with his chain to the Commander of the Faithful (peace be upon him),
He said: Do not face the sun (with your body), for it causes evaporation; it darkens the complexion, wears out clothing, and reveals the hidden ailment.
ai.seo_question: What are the health and physical effects of exposing oneself to the sun according to Imam Ali (AS)?
ai.summary: In this hadith from *Al-Khisal*, Imam Ali (peace be upon him) provides medical wisdom linking environmental exposure to health, noting that direct sunlight causes dehydration, skin discoloration, and the manifestation of latent ailments. This reflects the Shia scholarly tradition of integrating practical hygiene with spiritual and physical well-being, emphasizing the body as an amanah (trust) from God. The advice underscores the Prophetic tradition of preventive medicine, where avoiding harm is a precursor to maintaining health.
